feature_name: TLS 1.1 and earlier support deprecation in App Engine standard
summary: Support for TLS 1.1 and earlier is deprecated in App Engine standard, with a recommendation to use TLS 1.2 or later; deprecated on March 2025.
extended_definition: Support for TLS 1.1 and earlier is deprecated in App Engine standard, with a recommendation to use TLS 1.2 or later; deprecated on March 2025.
